FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Parcel Plus Solutions specializes in mail and packaging services, offering a range of solutions for personal and business shipping needs. Our core operations include packaging, shipping, and delivery of parcels through reliable carriers like USPS, FedEx, and UPS. We also provide limited ancillary services, such as basic printing and notary services, ensuring a secure environment with basic security measures in place to protect against theft. Our team is trained in proper packaging and shipping procedures to minimize errors and enhance customer satisfaction. We adhere strictly to local, state, and federal regulations governing shipping and data protection, thereby mitigating any potential liabilities. Our focus on conventional mail and parcel delivery services allows us to maintain a well-managed risk profile while ensuring efficient operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any ancillary services beyond basic printing, notary, and retail sales of shipping supplies, and confirms that its Business Personal Property (BPP) values do not exceed $500,000. Additionally, we have no history of accepting businesses with frequent or severe claims in the past five years and ensure full compliance with all local, state, and federal shipping and data protection regulations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: March 15, 2022; Cause: Theft of packages due to insufficient security measures; Amount: $1,000; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Basic security measures in place, including locks and surveillance cameras, with regular review and updates.
